description: Defaults for the QELM concentration reproduction (arXiv:2603.13005): paper Table I hyperparameters, shared reservoir/readout/dataset settings, and a lightweight runnable Landsat readout run at 8 qubits with one seed of each kind. Named configs in configs/ overlay this file and select their task via 'task' and the matching task section.
_comment_data_root: Relative to this paper folder, i.e. <repo>/data. Needed because the shared runtime's repo-root detection stops at this folder (it holds implementation.py). Override with --data-root, or with --data-root "$DATA_DIR" to use the DATA_DIR environment variable.

hyperparameters._comment: Paper Table I ('used in all experiments'). h_min enforces h > 0.1 (paper Sec. II).

reservoir._comment: encoding_period 4 = 1 encoding : 3 dynamics layers. input_shift is the cyclic shift of the input vector between encoding layers. Paper Fig. 1 layout: block_order 'figure1' = RZ(h)_2 RZZ(J) RX(b)xRX(b) RZZ(J) RZ(h)_2; bell_pairs 'odd' = Bell cups on (1,2),...,(N-1,0); brickwall_offset 0 = layer 0 on (0,1),(2,3),... angle_scale 2.0 turns the Qiskit half-angle gates into exp(-i theta P) with theta the labelled coefficient (RZZ(2J), RX(2b), RZ(2h)); it reproduces the Fig. 2 stars (LOG.md). chunk_size = samples simulated at once.

landsat._comment: Paper: 860 of 6435 rows, inputs = two stacked copies of the 36 features. Subset and split are unpublished; ours are stratified and seeded. input_scaling: 'minmax' maps each feature to [-1, 1] with training min/max (default); 'standard' uses training z-scores. The paper does not state its QELM input scaling.

narma._comment: Paper App. Methods: T_init 100 (discarded), T_train 250, T_test 250. input_encoding 'unit_interval' maps u ~ Unif(0, 0.5) to Unif(-1, 1) as the paper states; its literal formula 2u - 1 would give [-1, 0] ('two_u_minus_one', ablation).

landsat_readouts._comment_realisations: null: every (split, reservoir) pair of split_seeds x reservoir_seeds; otherwise an explicit list of [split_seed, reservoir_seed] pairs.
landsat_readouts._comment_probability_sources: null: simulate. Otherwise run directories (relative to this paper folder) whose saved probabilities_split*_res*.npz are reused; their config must match on circuit, hyperparameters, dataset and dtype.
